This one is going to require a story.

So, this was in Rust. Back when it was playable.

I was on this server for a while that had about 80 people on it total. So during the day there were usually about 10-15 people on, and at night there was normally around 5-10. Well one night it was just me and this other guy, and we chatted for a while.

Eventually we started voice chat. He had just restarted after losing everything, he did have a few items that I could use. So I offered to put him up in my little house I had built.

When I logged in the game the next night, everything was gone. I respawned in a random location on the map and walked back to my house. It had been raided, everything right down to the most useless items were gone.

I laughed for about twenty minutes. The dude I helped had taken me for a ride. He had changed his name on steam, but I quickly found him again. I memorized who he was and would check when he was on.

Him and his gang were quickly called the Phobia's, and they rampaged around the server murdering people and raiding houses. My friend, and some other friends in server. We planned our counter attack/vengeance a few nights after the other friends had been raided.

We set up a shelter right on the road where they were sure to spot it, and once they came up to it (about 8 or 9 of them) they started talking out loud about whether it was worth the C4 or not to get it open. But when they heard someone moving on the inside, they couldn't resist. And right when they planted the C4 we made our move.

Only 3 of us were outside the shelter, 2 inside. The 3 outside blasted them with the rifle, and then switched to assault weapons. They were all facing the wrong way, so when they turned around they forgot to run from their own C4 and thus killed about 3 of their members. We killed another 2. Then the dudes bursted out of the shelter with shotguns, and killed the remaining. We wiped them out so quick they barely knew what hit them.

My friend and I did a little victory celebration that night. He got tired and went to bed until it was just me and a few other people on... until the Phobia's logged back in.

I knew something was wrong when they didn't respond to my taunts. So I just picked up all the gear I had in my house, with my friends avatar sleeping on the floor.

They showed up within five minutes. The guy who originally ripped me off said over mic chat "MEESEEKS BUDDY! I'm BACK. Open the door." Needless to say, I didn't. I started to make my way to the top of my base where I had a back exit. "Think you guys can fuck with us? HEY." They began planting C4 on my base walls. And I was running opening doors in front of me and closing them behind me. The place I built was a maze, but it wouldn't keep them out long. My heart was pounding as I raced to the top. One of them blew up a wall right next to me, but before he could shoot I ran through the door and slammed it shut.

I got to the top of the base, and there was a Phobia there, waiting to make sure I couldn't get out. He didn't spot me (my back exit was well hidden), so I pulled out my rifle and headshot him in his god damn Phobia face.

I jumped down from my base, I missed the landing spot and broke a leg. Luckily, an explosion went off at the same time so they were unaware I had gotten out. But I couldn't move fast.

I went the only direction I could. I ran for a wasteland with no food or any resources of any kind.

I went in the middle of this desert, with my heart still pounding, I listened to them taunting me about whether to kill my friend or not (still sleeping on the floor), they did of course. But I was long gone with all the good loot they had left... I planned my vengeance once again...

And next day the admins wiped the server...

Nothing came close to actually competing for the hall, it took all of the competitive team matches and put the best euro asian and north american teams into a 3 way king of the hill.

Not only did you know you were the best in your continent (currently competing) but that you were also playing the best in the world.

If you won, it opened up the furnace of sorrows and the underworld, two exceptionally elite areas not normally accessible where rare materials could be found, and it broadcasted your team wins to literally everyone. If you ever entered the hall your chat would be instantly flooded with thousands of people cheering for you, and if you won it was mayhem.

Add to that that the mechanics were highly abuseable for some very clever and original team strats and gw1 pvp was truly something special no one has come close to emulating.

Camping IDOCs in Ultima Online.

In short, player housing in UO would slowly decay through various stages if left unattended, the last stage being 'In Danger of Collapsing'. When a house went IDOC it would fall within a day or two; though the timer wasn't random it was hidden so you were unlikely to have anything better than a rough estimate as to when that would be. On falling the house would instantly disappear and all of the, often enormously valuable, items its unfortunate owner had stored in it would fall to the ground free for the taking.

So there you'd sit; hidden against the outer wall near some juicy looking loot, for hour upon hour, in trembling anticipation of the moment when the house would suddenly, silently vanish and the maybe fifteen seconds of frenzied activity when everyone would burst out, grab what they could and escape. At any moment while you're waiting calamity could strike - a PK guild might gate in to bloodily claim the house for themselves; some other camper could get bored or have to leave and in spite post the location of the IDOC on a public forum, calling down hundreds of rivals and probably a few PVP guilds to squabble over the now crowded and practically worthless territory; or worst of all, the house's owner could log in, open the front door, and in doing so refresh its condition back to Like New.

Eve Online.

There have been many moments..

Like the time I was a fresh new scrub and joined my first corp which shortly after was wardecced by an evil newbie hating merc corp. They hell camped us for day and people were getting their jimmies rustled. No one wanted to undock from our safe station and the higher ups were telling us to starve them of kills and not to end up on the killboard.

After a few days of being camped in not being able to make Isk there was some massive merc ship sitting right outside our station and about 30 of our guys cowering inside. Something came over me, probably mostly stupidity and I decided to undock in my crappy low level tier 1 Rifter and see if I could take him. Of cause I couldn't, but that didn't matter. To cries of disbelieve on Teamspeak I undocked and went at him, afterburner and every module blazing, not giving a toss if I came out alive or not. I had to try.

So I had undocked, burned at this massive ship and not only managed to bump him (preventing him docking as he was out of range) but also land a tackle module on him (meaning he couldn't warp away). Suddenly Teamspeak lit up with orders for everyone to undock all the things and shoot him.

It felt like bloody forever but we eventually took the guy down and I even survived. The whole corp lost their collective minds at that point on Teamspeak and we'd won the moral and Isk war by several fold. I was ten foot tall and bulletproof for the rest of the day IRL. Never has a game made me sweat and fear so much.
